pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 (Not Only... But Also)
meaningEn: Adding additional information ('not only... but also').
meaningId: Menambahkan informasi tambahan ('tidak hanya... tetapi juga').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 / Consonant stem -> ~을 뿐만 아니라. Noun: Noun + 뿐만 아니라.
notesEn.usage: Used to connect two facts about a subject, emphasizing that both apply equally.
notesEn.nuance: The tone of both clauses should align (either both positive or both negative).

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 뿐만 아니라. Kata Benda: Kata Benda + 뿐만 아니라.
notesId.usage: Digunakan untuk menghubungkan dua fakta tentang suatu subjek, menekankan bahwa keduanya berlaku secara setara.
notesId.nuance: Nada kedua klausa harus sejalan (keduanya positif atau keduanya negatif).

examples.hangul: 이 음식은 맛있을 뿐만 아니라 건강에도 좋아요.
examples.romaja: i eum-sig-eun mas-iss-eul ppun-man a-ni-ra geon-gang-e-do jo-a-yo.
examples.meaningEn: This food is not only delicious, but also good for health.
examples.meaningId: Makanan ini tidak hanya enak, tetapi juga bagus untuk kesehatan.

examples.hangul: 그 사람은 친절할 뿐만 아니라 일도 잘해요.
examples.romaja: geu sa-ram-eun chin-jeol-hal ppun-man a-ni-ra il-do jal-hae-yo.
examples.meaningEn: That person is not only kind, but also works well.
examples.meaningId: Orang itu tidak hanya ramah, tetapi juga bekerja dengan baik.

examples.hangul: 한국어뿐만 아니라 영어도 할 수 있어요.
examples.romaja: han-gug-eo-ppun-man a-ni-ra yeong-eo-do hal su is-seo-yo.
examples.meaningEn: I can speak not only Korean, but also English.
examples.meaningId: Saya bisa berbicara tidak hanya bahasa Korea, tetapi juga bahasa Inggris.

quiz.question: Which construction means 'not only... but also' for adjectives?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 connects two parallel traits or facts ('not only... but also').
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 menghubungkan dua sifat atau fakta sejajar ('tidak hanya... tetapi juga').

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: This food is not only delicious... -> 이 음식은 맛있을 ___ 건강에도 좋아요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert suffix meaning 'not only... but also'.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan akhiran yang berarti 'tidak hanya... tetapi juga'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'This food is not only delicious, but also good for health.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Makanan ini tidak hanya enak, tetapi juga bagus untuk kesehatan.'
constructionQuiz.answer: 이 음식은 맛있을 뿐만 아니라 건강에도 좋아요
constructionQuiz.answerReading: i eum-sig-eun mas-iss-eul ppun-man a-ni-ra geon-gang-e-do jo-a-yo
acceptableVariants: 이 음식은 맛있을 뿐만 아니라 건강에도 좋습니다
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use this food (이 음식은) + delicious not only (맛있을 뿐만 아니라) + health also good (건강에도 좋아요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan makanan ini (이 음식은) + tidak hanya enak (맛있을 뿐만 아니라) + kesehatan juga bagus (건강에도 좋아요).

pattern: Verb/Adj Stem + ~(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 (On the Other Hand / While)
meaningEn: Contrasting two opposing sides or characteristics ('on the other hand / whereas').
meaningId: Membandingkan dua sisi atau sifat yang berlawanan ('sebaliknya / sedangkan').

notesEn.formation: Present Verb: ~는 반면에 / Adj & Past Verb: ~(으)ㄴ 반면에.
notesEn.usage: Used when comparing two contrasting facts, qualities, or situations.

notesId.formation: Kata Kerja Present: ~는 반면에 / Kata Sifat & Kata Kerja Lampau: ~(으)ㄴ 반면에.
notesId.usage: Digunakan saat membandingkan dua fakta, kualitas, atau situasi yang berlawanan.

examples.meaningEn: It is warm during the day, whereas it is cold at night.
examples.meaningId: Siang hari hangat, sedangkan malam hari dingin.

examples.meaningEn: The older brother is diligent, while the younger sibling is lazy.

examples.hangul: 이 옷은 예쁜 반면에 가격이 비싸요.
examples.romaja: i os-eun ye-ppeun ban-myeon-e ga-gyeog-i bi-ssa-yo.
examples.meaningEn: This clothing is pretty, on the other hand, the price is expensive.
examples.meaningId: Baju ini cantik, tetapi sebaliknya harganya mahal.

quiz.question: Which connector expresses contrast meaning 'on the other hand / whereas'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 directly contrasts two distinct attributes or scenarios.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄴ/는 반면에 secara langsung mempertentangkan dua atribut atau skenario yang berbeda.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: It is warm during the day, whereas it is cold at night. -> 낮에는 따뜻한 ___ 밤에는 추워요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert contrast connector meaning 'on the other hand'.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata penghubung pertentangan yang berarti 'sebaliknya'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'It is warm during the day, whereas it is cold at night.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Siang hari hangat, sedangkan malam hari dingin.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use daytime (낮에는) + warm contrast (따뜻한 반면에) + nighttime (밤에는) + cold (추워요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan siang hari (낮에는) + kontras hangat (따뜻한 반면에) + malam hari (밤에는) + dingin (추워요).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 (Only / Merely - High Formal)
meaningEn: Expressing that something is strictly the only action/feeling ('can only be / merely').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa sesuatu adalah satu-satunya tindakan/perasaan ('hanya bisa / tak lain hanya').

notesEn.formation: Vowel stem -> ~ㄹ 따름이다 / Consonant stem -> ~을 따름이다.
notesEn.nuance: Often used in speeches, writing, or formal apologies/gratitude (e.g., 감사할 따름입니다 / 죄송할 따름입니다).

notesId.formation: Kata Dasar berakhiran Vokal -> ~ㄹ 따름이다 / Kata Dasar berakhiran Konsonan -> ~을 따름이다.
notesId.usage: Ekuivalen yang sangat formal/literatur dari ~(으)ㄹ 뿐이다.
notesId.nuance: Sering digunakan dalam pidato, tulisan, atau ucapan maaf/terima kasih formal (contoh: 감사할 따름입니다 / 죄송할 따름입니다).

examples.meaningEn: I am merely grateful for your help.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya bisa berterima kasih atas bantuan Anda.

examples.meaningEn: I can only offer my deepest apologies for my mistake.
examples.meaningId: Saya hanya bisa meminta maaf yang sebesar-besarnya atas kesalahan saya.

examples.meaningEn: I am simply doing my best.

quiz.question: Which ending is a formal literary synonym for '~(으)ㄹ 뿐이다'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 is a formal, written equivalent expressing 'merely/only'.
quiz.explanationId: ~(으)ㄹ 따름이다 adalah ekuivalen ragam tulis/formal yang menyatakan 'hanya/sekadar'.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: I am merely grateful for your help. -> 도움을 주셔서 감사할 ___입니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan kata benda terikat formal yang berarti 'hanya/sekadar'.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean (formal high): 'I am merely grateful for your help.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea (formal tingkat tinggi): 'Saya hanya bisa berterima kasih atas bantuan Anda.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use help giving cause (도움을 주셔서) + grateful modifier (감사할) + merely formal (따름입니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan alasan memberi bantuan (도움을 주셔서) + penjelas bersyukur (감사할) + sekadar formal (따름입니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~기 마련이다 (Bound to / Natural Consequence)
meaningEn: Expressing that something naturally happens or is inevitable ('bound to happen').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa sesuatu secara alami pasti terjadi ('pasti / wajar jika').

notesEn.usage: States a universal truth, natural law, or expected outcome given human nature or reality.
notesEn.nuance: Translates to 'it is natural that...' or 'is bound to...'

notesId.usage: Menyatakan kebenaran universal, hukum alam, atau hasil yang sudah diperkirakan mengingat sifat manusia atau realitas.

examples.meaningEn: With the passage of time, it is bound to be forgotten.
examples.meaningId: Seiring berjalannya waktu, hal itu pasti akan terlupakan.

examples.meaningEn: Everyone is bound to make mistakes.

examples.hangul: 열심히 노력하면 좋은 결과가 있기 마련이에요.
examples.romaja: yeol-sim-hi no-ryeok-ha-myeon jo-eun gyeol-gwa-ga it-gi ma-ryeon-i-e-yo.
examples.meaningEn: If you try hard, good results are bound to follow.
examples.meaningId: Jika berusaha keras, pasti akan ada hasil yang baik.

quiz.question: What is the meaning of '~기 마련이다'?
options: It is bound to happen naturally
I plan to do it soon
quiz.explanationEn: ~기 마련이다 states that an outcome is a natural, unavoidable certainty.
quiz.explanationId: ~기 마련이다 menyatakan bahwa suatu hasil adalah kepastian yang alami dan tidak terhindarkan.

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Everyone is bound to make mistakes. -> 사람은 누구나 실수하___ 입니다.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Insert nominalizer + bound noun for natural consequence.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Masukan pengubah kata benda + kata benda terikat untuk konsekuensi alami.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Everyone is bound to make mistakes.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Setiap orang pasti membuat kesalahan.'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use person (사람은) + anyone (누구나) + make mistake (실수하) + bound to (기 마련입니다).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan orang (사람은) + siapa saja (누구나) + buat kesalahan (실수하) + pasti (기 마련입니다).

pattern: Verb Stem + ~아/어 봤자 (Even If / No Use Trying)
meaningEn: Expressing that an action will yield no useful result ('even if / no matter how much').
meaningId: Mengekspresikan bahwa suatu tindakan tidak akan membuahkan hasil yang berguna ('meskipun / percuma jika').

notesEn.usage: Used when the speaker believes attempting an action is futile or won't change the outcome significantly.
notesEn.nuance: Followed by negative statements, doubts, or useless outcome predictions.

notesId.usage: Digunakan ketika pembicara percaya bahwa mencoba suatu tindakan adalah sia-sia atau tidak akan mengubah hasil secara signifikan.
notesId.nuance: Diikuti oleh pernyataan negatif, keraguan, atau prediksi hasil yang tidak berguna.

examples.meaningEn: Even if you run now, you will still be late.
examples.meaningId: Meskipun kamu berlari sekarang, percuma karena pasti akan terlambat.

examples.meaningEn: Even if you regret it, it's no use.

examples.hangul: 그 사람에게 말해 봤자 안 들을 거예요.
examples.romaja: geu sa-ram-e-ge mal-hae bwat-ja an deu-reul geo-ye-yo.
examples.meaningEn: Even if you tell him, he won't listen.
examples.meaningId: Meskipun kamu memberi tahu orang itu, dia tidak akan mendengarkan.

quiz.question: Which sentence means 'Even if you regret it, it's no use'?
quiz.explanationEn: ~아/어 봤자 expresses futility ('even if / no use trying').

fillInTheBlank.sentenceEn: Even if you regret it, it's no use. -> 후회해 ___ 소용없어요.
fillInTheBlank.hintEn: Attach futility connector after verb form 후회해.
fillInTheBlank.hintId: Tempelkan kata penghubung kesia-siaan setelah bentuk kata kerja 후회해.

constructionQuiz.promptEn: Translate to Korean: 'Even if you regret it, it's no use.'
constructionQuiz.promptId: Terjemahkan ke bahasa Korea: 'Percuma menyesal (tidak ada gunanya).'
constructionQuiz.hintEn: Use regret (후회해) + even if futile (봤자) + no use (소용없어요).
constructionQuiz.hintId: Gunakan menyesal (후회해) + meskipun percuma (봤자) + tidak berguna (소용없어요).
